name: StickerPeel-TS-TW
blurb: Draggable sticker with a corner peel effect on hover.
description: Renders an image with a 3D peel-up corner effect that responds to hover and drag. Uses GSAP for animations and SVG filters for lighting and shadow.
use_when: Interactive product showcases, promotional stickers, or playful UI elements that benefit from tactile feel.
avoid_when: Dense layouts (stickers are large and draggable); low-contrast scenarios where shadow depth is critical.
a11y: Draggable sticker; keyboard interaction depends on GSAP Draggable support. No built-in reduced-motion handling.
